name: Merri Creek Planting Day
description: Join us for a morning of native tree planting along the Merri Creek corridor. All tools and refreshments provided.

name: Fitzroy Pocket Park Build
description: Help us transform an unused lot in Fitzroy into a vibrant community pocket park with native plantings.

name: Native Grass Seed Collection
description: Learn about native grasses and help collect seeds for our revegetation nursery program.

name: Yarra Bank Weed Removal
description: Help restore the Yarra riverbank by removing invasive weeds and planting native ground cover.

name: Schoolyard Greening Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop for teachers and parents on creating green spaces in schoolyards.

name: Westgate Park Revegetation
description: Continue the award-winning revegetation program at Westgate Park with new native plantings.

name: Darebin Creek Bird Habitat Restoration
description: Help create habitat corridors for native birds along the Darebin Creek with understorey planting.

name: Carlton Rooftop Garden Project
description: Join our pilot rooftop garden project, transforming an inner-city building into a green oasis.

name: Indigenous Plants Walk & Talk
description: A guided walk with an Indigenous elder exploring traditional uses of native plants in the Melbourne region.
